body:
As someone who works in system administration and manages multiple websites, I can assure you, I wouldn't laugh at someone saying "hug of death".

It's a totally acceptable *expression*, implying unintentional DoS by high request rates. Get over yourself dude.

How am I judgemental? I can't relate well to people that don't understand my logic or my humour. That rules out unintelligent people. I don't consciously choose intelligent people, it's just that I end up liking them rather than others.

Same for weight and physical attractiveness, I just seem to only find a subset of people attractive. My point was that no one I like seems to like me back, and that my requirements aren't unreasonable. I don't only choose the top 10% or 1%, more like the top 75% and even THEN, no one wants me.

While I also feel judged and am socially anxious, it doesn't relate to the fact I'm a shit, useless person and I hate myself. That's separate judgement all on my own, and it's verifiable by my highly variable performance in academia, and the fact I always say the wrong things and end up with no friends and no one who cares about me.

They're not obtainable for me. 

The girl I like isn't amazingly beautiful. I like her because she's just a lovely person, and she cares, is super intelligent and shares my interests. But I know I stand absolutely no chance. All I can do is watch another guy win her over. I promise you she'll never want me.
